features.name: Ability Score Adjustment
features.description: +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence and −2 Charisma.

features.name: Size
features.description: Medium size.

features.name: Type
features.description: Humanoid with Al Bhed subtype.

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: Land speed 30 feet.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Start Common and Albhedian. With high INT, choose bonus languages from Goblin, Loporrit, Moogle, PuPon and Yagudo.

features.name: Desert Nomad
features.description: +4 racial on CON checks and Fort saves to avoid fatigue, exhaustion or harmful effects of running, forced marches, starvation, thirst, and hot or cold environments.

condition.description: Only circumstances listed: fatigue, exhaustion, running, forced marches, hunger, thirst, extreme temperature

features.name: Trap Knowledge
features.description: +2 racial to saves against mechanical traps.

features.name: Fixer-Upper
features.description: Repair is a class skill. No missing-toolkit penalty to Repair. Fixing construct damage with Repair takes 30 minutes.

features.name: Mechanical Genius
features.description: At character level 1, get one extra skill rank and select one specialty to gain +2 racial skill modifier among Knowledge (engineering), Profession (engineering), Craft (any), Disable Device, Use Magical Device. Eligible skills are class skills.

features.name: Skill Training
features.description: Drive and Pilot are class skills.

features.name: Technologist
features.description: Gain Technologist bonus feat.

effects.textValue: Grant Technologist bonus feat directly from racial feature; reference feat definition not yet imported.

features.name: Weapon Familiarity
features.description: Proficient with Simple Firearms.

features.name: Knowledge (engineering) choice bonus
features.description: Selecting Knowledge (engineering) applies only this choice’s benefit. Other options are not granted.

features.name: Profession (engineering) choice bonus
features.description: Selecting Profession (engineering) applies only this choice’s benefit. Other options are not granted.

features.name: Disable Device choice bonus
features.description: Selecting Disable Device applies only this choice’s benefit. Other options are not granted.

features.name: Use Magical Device choice bonus

features.name: Academician
features.description: Select one Knowledge specialty for +2 bonus; replaces Technologist.

features.name: Child of the Sea
features.description: +4 racial Swim and Profession (sailor) and Wisdom checks to pilot vessels; cannot become lost at sea. Replaces Desert Nomad.

features.name: Explorer
features.description: +2 racial Acrobatics, Climb, Swim; each is a class skill. Replaces Mechanical Genius and Desert Nomad.

features.name: Magic Resistant
features.description: Spell resistance 11 + total character level; can lower for one round with standard action; −2 to concentration checks for spells. Replaces Fixer-Upper and Weapon Familiarity.

features.name: Mechanical Dismantler
features.description: +4 racial to Steal maneuvers versus Machina subtype. Replaces Skill Training.

features.name: Xenophobic
features.description: Speak only Al Bhed, with no high-INT bonus languages. Linguistics grants one language per TWO ranks. +1 on saves vs mind-affecting effects EXCEPT fear. Replaces Languages, retaining no Common.

effects.textValue: Albhedian only; zero INT bonus languages; one new language per two Linguistics ranks

features.name: Wary
features.description: +1 racial Sense Motive and Bluff. Replaces Desert Nomad.
